# Product brief — AI Research Workspace

> C1 student artifact. Replace prompts with decisions and evidence. Keep this brief enough to guide a first release.

## Problem
What research task is painful today? What evidence shows the pain?

## Target User
Name one primary user and the context in which they work.

## Current Workflow
List the steps the user takes now, including where sources or provenance get lost.

## Jobs To Be Done
When ___, I want to ___, so that ___.

## MVP
List the smallest end-to-end flow: private knowledge → research task → evidence → sourced report → human-approved note. State the acceptance condition for each capability.

## Non-goals
State deliberate exclusions such as teams, OCR, browser agents and autonomous writes.

## User Flow
Sketch entry, main path, failure/retry and completion. Identify Dashboard, Knowledge, Research, Runs and detail views only when they support the flow.

## Success Criteria
Define observable product outcomes and safety constraints. Include source traceability and zero unauthorized writes.

## Open Questions
List decisions that need a test, user feedback or later evidence. Assign an owner and a due lesson.
